title: 玩家操作无响应或无效
description: 玩家输入或操作对游戏状态没有预期效果，包括攻击无效、速度异常、对话无进展、角色不听从指令、地图点击漂移等。
evidence: The AI is not good, you need to babysit your crew or they might do stupid things.
Your attacks did not affect the enemy armor
Flying and all of a sudden for no reason yo go from 150m vsec to none, no impact no collision nothing

evidence_items.quote: Improved space map interaction (often click it and it just drifts off to the abyss)
evidence_items.description: 点击太空地图时，飞船会漂向深渊
evidence_items.quote_zh: 改进太空地图交互（经常点击它，它就飘向深渊）

evidence_items.quote: complex to a point where I died cause of one wrong click
evidence_items.description: 一次误点击导致角色死亡，操作容错极低
evidence_items.quote_zh: 复杂到因为一次误点我就死了

evidence_items.quote: Flying and all of a sudden for no reason yo go from 150m vsec to none, no impact no collision nothing
evidence_items.description: 飞行时速度无故从150m/s骤降，且无碰撞或撞击
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞行时，突然无缘无故地，你的速度从150米/秒直接归零，没有撞击，没有碰撞，什么都没有

evidence_items.quote: The AI is not good, you need to babysit your crew or they might do stupid things.
evidence_items.description: 船员AI不听话，需要全程照看，否则会做出蠢事。
evidence_items.quote_zh: AI不好，你得照看你的船员，否则他们可能会做蠢事。

evidence_items.quote: there's no obvious way to just DO NOTHING. JUST STAND THERE FOR A SECOND BRO.
evidence_items.description: 角色自动执行任务，无法让其原地待命
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有明显的方法能直接什么都不做。就站那儿一秒钟，兄弟。

evidence_items.quote: Your attacks did not affect the enemy armor
evidence_items.description: 近战攻击对敌人护甲无效
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你的攻击没有影响敌人的护甲

evidence_items.quote: I absolutely hate the dialogue system, having to spend literally hours just going in circles (asking "how they're doing" 50 times in a single chat is apparently perfectly normal)
evidence_items.description: 对话系统中，玩家花费数小时绕圈子，询问相同问题，没有实际效果。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我绝对讨厌这个对话系统，不得不花上好几个小时原地打转（在一次聊天里问50遍“他们过得怎么样”显然是完全正常的）
